Historical audit sources
========================

These files are byte-for-byte snapshots of `src/dynabench/benchmarks/libero/suite.py`
and `src/dynabench/simulators/mujoco/dynamics.py` at the original development
commits named by their parent directories. They are test data, not executable
modules. Keep their contents unchanged: the released audit manifests record
their SHA-256 hashes. Including them lets the checks run without the private
development Git history.
